text:
Mia: Heads-up — rolling out a central CI templates repo (org: redwood/ci-templates) starting next Monday. Aim: one source of truth for workflow best-practices, security steps, and caching. Opt-in first week, automated migration after two weeks. :rocket:
Carlos: Nice. Will this change how self-hosted runner pools pick configs?
Mia: No runner changes. Workflows will reference templates by `uses: redwood/ci-templates/.github/workflows/<name>@<tag>` so teams can keep their runners.
Anita: Quick Q — what about org-level secrets / vault access?
Mia: We keep secrets the same. Templates will expect certain secret names (DOCUMENTED). For vault access we added an optional step `with: use-vault: true`.
Sam: Any rollout checklist for services that do weird matrix builds?
Mia: Yep — TL;DR checklist below. If you have multi-matrix jobs, add `preserve-matrix: true` to the `ci-template` usage or skip automatic migration.
devex-bot: ACTION: created PR redwood/ci-templates#12 — added node and python base templates.
Mia: Example usage (copy into .github/workflows):
```yaml
name: CI
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  test:
    uses: redwood/ci-templates/.github/workflows/node.yml@v1.0.0
    with:
      node-version: 18
      cache-key: ${{ matrix.os }}-deps
```
Anita: Will there be linting enforced? We already have a few repos with divergent steps.
Mia: Yes — during opt-in week linting is advisory. After cutover we enable `ci-lint` as a check on PRs (configured via branch-protection rule). If your repo fails lint, auto-migration will create a draft PR to help.
Carlos: How do teams opt-out? We have a couple of infra-only repos that require custom Jenkins hooks.
Mia: Opt-out by adding `ci-templates: ignore` to repo root `redwood.config.yml` and file an exemption in the migration tracker. Exemptions are timeboxed and require Eng Platform approval.
Anita: Any rollback plan if a mass break happens?
Mia: Rollback plan: 1) Pause migration job, 2) Auto-revert draft PRs, 3) Run fast-fail runner: `scripts/ci-smoke --org <repo>` to validate. Sam + Eng Platform will monitor deploy dashboards.
Sam: I'll add smoke checks to the SRE runbook and watch the first two days.
Mia: Migration schedule: Opt-in open Mon-Fri next week (manual one-click in console). Automated migration runs the following Tuesday 02:00 UTC. Exceptions need to be filed by Friday end-of-day.
Mia: Quick checklist (copy this into PR template):
- Add `uses` reference to the template or opt-out tag
- Run `./scripts/ci-validate` locally (or via action)
- Fix lint warnings (ci-lint reports are in PR checks)
- Add `preserve-matrix: true` if you use custom matrix logic
- Confirm secrets (DOCS link)
Carlos: Docs link?
Mia: https://redwood.internal.dev/ci-templates (internal) — has migration guide, examples, and exemption form.
Anita: sounds reasonable. We'll run on a fork first.
Mia: If any team wants pair-migration help ping @Mia or drop a note in #devex. We'll have office hours Wed 1500–1700 PT.
Carlos: 👍 marking on our roadmap.
Anita: thanks — will schedule a short run-through with my team.
Mia: Will post progress updates here during rollout. Please react with :thumbsup: if you're good with the schedule.
